description: Labeled retrieval pairs for the real-embedder check (E43) and for calibrating the minimum cosine (DECISIONS §10). Queries are built from structured requests, as the agent builds them; documents are canonical memory texts. 'relevant' and 'irrelevant' are disjoint; global notes are 'neutral' (always eligible, mildly related at most) and are not used for the threshold.
